build_checks: Smali assembly and APK resource build

preserved.pin_setup_pair_and_withdrawal_timing: Original 26.14.3 code, with hostname guards mapped to original trusted app origins.

features.gate: Matrix prompt until the first confirmed choice; choice and optional code persist through normal restarts. Existing Limpar resets the choice. Original scheme, host and port retained; registration uses /home/register?id=code.
features.settings: Single row beside existing cleanup row in /home/mine only; existing route-local observer reused; no polling interval
features.configuration_persistence: Private .mint_mod_state/config.json outside original reset target directories; Restore defaults resets mods; uninstall/Android system clear still removes it.
features.credentials: Empty by default; explicit Apply; proxy credentials never enter page config.
features.mines: JDB Mines adapter gated by /h5/games/9/9014/ on the original selected game address, with configurable history and wager count.
features.network_policy: 12 captured exact image paths and 4 exact promotional API paths, independent of host. Filtering remains inside the original app page scope; intercepted requests are blocked before download.
features.before_render_policy: Same two Vue target render vetoes from 26.14.3; same known limitations on app discovery timing.
features.proxy: HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 with credentials; app WebViews and the existing HTML compatibility fetch use local proxy adapter. Native unrelated SDK/API clients are outside this routing.
features.proxy_control: One ongoing notification with proxy toggle ON/OFF and a separate Atualizar action for the current page.
features.manual_action_permission: All trusted clicks grant a temporary 5-second exemption to custom request/artwork filters and manual popup openings; unsolicited work outside the exemption stays filtered.

limitations: No runtime or device tests performed; user performs them.
Pre-render guard requires matching Vue structure and cannot retroactively prevent a dialog mounted before discovery.
Manually opened chest eligibility and rewards remain subject to server conditions.
Proxy routing does not cover unrelated native SDK requests or other applications.
Android can suppress/dismiss the notification or stop the service; permanent availability cannot override OS restrictions.
Game overlay depends on existing JDB 9014 path and brteachcor game layout.

fix_v71.cause: Port scope used only seeded origins while LiteHooks dynamically accepts selected/redirected origins; mods could reject a page accepted by the original profile integration.

refresh_v72.operation: WebView.reload(), deferred through existing proxy-transition callback if pending
refresh_v72.ip_behavior: New page requests use the current network/proxy; reload does not itself acquire a new IP. Existing connections or server behavior may retain earlier observations.
refresh_v72.when_no_live_page: Shows message asking to open the app; does not recreate a page from background.

registration_v73.previous_issue: Code was added only to the first native loadUrl; SPA navigation could enter /home/register without id. Startup choice was not persisted across launches.
registration_v73.fallback_full_document_load_when_router_: On entry without a correctly bootstrapped code; avoids repeated reloads while already bootstrapped.

manual_actions_v74.user_instruction: Any deliberate action should be permitted; unsolicited automatic elements should remain filtered.
manual_actions_v74.trigger: Any trusted click in the app page; no label/class whitelist. Touching/scrolling alone and script-generated clicks do not grant a permit.
manual_actions_v74.network: Existing four promotional API paths and filtered artwork have a temporary native/JS permit. No bodies, headers, account claims or response success values are forged.
manual_actions_v74.dialogs: Existing cosmetic rule families allow newly observed manual roots through their normal close lifecycle. Already marked blocked roots remain blocked. The two component render vetoes accept manual opens.
limitations: Time-window heuristic cannot prove request causality. Coincident automatic work can also pass.
Responses or dialogs arriving after the window may require a new gesture.
Reused dialog nodes without an observable hidden/unmounted state may retain the prior manual exception.
ServiceWorker/legacy image callbacks use a brief shared permitted window because they lack a WebView owner.
manual_actions_v74.video_review: User-provided video9.mp4 shows Mission / Novo Usuario / Baixe e faca login(Deposito), with Receber. No request trace or server response is in the video.
manual_actions_v74.source_issue: Previous whitelist did not recognize a plain Receber control. It was replaced by all deliberate trusted clicks as the user requested.
